title: Bicho (Critter)
summary: A per-visit articulated creature of hinged planes that moves only while you hold it and has no original to return to.
mechanism: A forward-kinematic linkage driven solely by pointer events (no rAF, no autoplay, no storage); motion exists only during manipulation, and each load re-mints a random, unrepeatable animal.
references: Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
